title: ligusticopsis involucrata
intro: Ligusticopsis involucrata, commonly known as Himalayan lovage or Himalayan ligusticum, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, as well as reducing inflammation and pain. The health benefits of Ligusticopsis involucrata are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and analgesic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
